title: Turn the agreed application plan into selectively readable knowledge
summary: Both plan layers and canonical hierarchy are selectively retrievable. Original passages have explicit destinations; source integrity and fresh-process navigation are verified.
body: There are 87 semantic plan topics for application and coding-context design plus separately retrievable canonical evidence. All 29 original agreement sections have clause coverage. Sources and historical revisions remain available. Component contracts are unchanged. Latest explicit instructions govern old snapshots. Human review is the remaining checkpoint step.

links.reason: Read current progress and the next component.
Inspect the first bounded clause coverage map.
Latest authorization to continue one component at a time.

layers.contains: Purpose, current checkpoint, brief active global rules, and component directory. No full module bodies or accumulated diary.
Purpose, owned responsibility, inputs, outputs, current progress, applicable rules, and an index of subcomponents.
One coherent question, behavior, rule, or design decision. Standalone explanation with enough context to understand it; not arbitrary heading or line-count chunks.
Exact source passages, revisions, reasons for changes, and linked commits. Read when provenance or evolution is relevant.

node_fields: Named outgoing links with when-to-follow explanations
Revision, timestamp and reason for change

edge_meanings.part_of: This detail belongs to this component.
edge_meanings.depends_on: A change to the target may affect this component; inspect the connection before changing anything else.
edge_meanings.uses: Read this shared rule or definition when applying this record.
edge_meanings.based_on: Read the original passage if exact wording or interpretation matters.
edge_meanings.supersedes: This explicitly replaces the linked older decision; age alone never cancels a rule.

session_reading: Read the small entry point and run the existing startup command.
Read the project map, current checkpoint and applicable global rules. Explain current position to Lohith.
Open the relevant component; show an index of child summaries instead of all child bodies.
Read only the children needed for the current task. Follow named cross-links when needed.
If context is missing, retrieve the linked detail. Do not fill the gap from assumptions or read every archive.
Save changed facts and meaningful decisions before moving on. A fresh session repeats this reading path without requiring the old chat.
change_handling: Revise the smallest coherent record. Preserve older revisions and the reason for the change.
Keep global and older applicable rules active until explicitly changed; a new topic does not replace them.
Use recorded dependencies to identify possibly affected components. Explain cross-component implications to Lohith; do not silently rewrite the entire plan.
Update affected records and tracker as one coherent change, then commit it separately with a descriptive label.
Keep routine tool events separate from decision records. Store useful outcomes, sources and evidence references rather than duplicating full chat transcripts in each node.
implementation_steps: Inventory meaningful clauses in the preserved agreement and later amendments; map each to its component and subcomponent. Reuse existing IDs wherever appropriate.
Keep a coverage mapping from source passages to semantic records or explicit historical/superseded decisions. Nothing should disappear during segmentation.
Populate component children with standalone explanations, applicable rules and exact source references. Shared facts live once and are linked elsewhere.
Add human-readable link reasons and component child indexes. Extend bounded CLI retrieval only where current commands cannot present these routes.
Show Lohith the actual Skills branch and one cross-component route, so he can judge whether the organization is understandable before repeating it throughout the plan.
Complete the remaining components. Check source coverage, dangling links, conflicting active decisions and a fresh-session navigation example.
Refresh tracker and startup instructions. Report separately what is stored, what can be retrieved and what remains unfinished in the application.
ready_now: Versioned records with named navigation and exact sources
Actual canonical profile, employers, systems, facts, metrics, boundaries and accomplishments
All original-agreement passages mapped with historical/superseded dispositions
Source/all-revision checks, stale-write rejection and rebuildable index
limits: The graph guides context selection; it does not itself restrict filesystem writes or guarantee no drift.
Missing dependency links can hide impact, so interfaces and changed files must still be inspected.
Portability requires the new agent to use the startup route. Automatic discovery and native tool logging vary by host.
This task does not change application behavior, resume requirements or model selection.
completion_evidence: Lohith can see where a specific agreed requirement lives.
A fresh process can retrieve one component and the necessary linked rules without the whole agreement.
Each meaningful source clause has a recorded destination or explicit supersession.
A changed node retains its previous revision and exposes known affected neighbors.
change_reason: Record completed migration as review, not acceptance

skills_pilot.note: Semantic records now exist; no application enforcement or user acceptance claimed.

completion_state: Implementation and verification ready for review.
